info.summary: This is a copy of the work done by Andreas Poehlmann with the goal to provide a pypi package for Ocean Optics spectrometers on Python 3.7

info.author: Andreas Poehlmann

info.summary: Python interface module for Ocean Optics spectrometers. This software is not associated with Ocean Optics. Use it at your own risk.
